# Student management

Right now the app only tracks student email addresses in activity signups. There is no student profile, grade level, or membership record.

## Recommended Solution

- Add a student model with email, name, and grade level.
- Use that model in signup responses and activity participant lists.
- Allow an admin interface or endpoint to view and manage student records.

## Context

Other school club systems manage members, and this makes signup data easier to understand and extend.
